subject: Redwood renewal & capacity plan — kickoff and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novacorp.com>, Alan Green <alan.green@novacorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood renewal & capacity plan — kickoff and QBR scheduling

Hi Sarah / Alan —

Thanks for the time last week. As we discussed, I want to kick off the renewal/expansion conversation for NovaCorp so we can lock in capacity for your Q4 launch and align on term/discount options. Proposed next steps below: 

- Confirm executive QBR window (two options below)
- Share an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) and proposed term sheet preview
- Identify procurement and security evidence items needed for PO/contract
- Internal staffing handoff and runbook for traffic ramp

QBR availability (please pick one):
  • Option A: Tue, Jul 9, 10:00–11:00 PT
  • Option B: Wed, Jul 10, 14:00–15:00 PT

I've attached a short preview of proposed terms and the MAP workbook. Kimberly will lead the contract side and Marissa will coordinate onboarding/staffing. Can you confirm a preferred QBR slot and share any procurement contacts we should loop in?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0191
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novacorp.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood renewal & capacity plan — kickoff and QBR scheduling

Hi Rishi —

Thanks — Jul 9 at 10:00 PT works best for our execs. I've looped in Procurement to start the PO timeline and Alan will help with capacity forecasts. A couple quick asks so we come prepared: 

1) Can you add a one-page summary of the proposed term changes (term length, committed throughput, overage pricing)?
2) We'll need SOC2 and data retention details for our security review — can Kimberly share the latest evidence pack or a short checklist of items?

I'll confirm any other stakeholders by Friday. See you Jul 9.

Best,
Sarah

Head of AI Platform, NovaCorp

Hi Sarah —

Great — I've attached a short evidence checklist and the most recent SOC 2 & compliance binder link in the MAP workbook. I'll also attach a one-page term summary in the follow-up note (attaching term preview here). 

Attachment stub: Redwood_renewal_preview_terms_2029-06-25.pdf (term summary)
Attachment stub: Mutual_Action_Plan_NovaCorp_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook)

On terms: we prepared two sensible paths — 12-month committed capacity with a stepped pricing ladder, or an 18-month term with a deeper commit discount. We'll surface recommended option for cost/performance trade-offs in the QBR. If there are procurement constraints (billing cadence or PO requirements), please flag them now and we'll adapt.

Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

- I'll own the runbook for the first 90 days and request the technical contact from NovaCorp (we should get an initial load profile)

- I'll prepare a short demo of burst handling and autoscaling behavior (10 min) — need Connor to sign off on the slides.

Connor (looping you): can you confirm bandwidth for the demo and whether we want to include the live KV-cache demo?
